point_policy: Uses the same 22 radix-4096 columns, two ranges for full columns, original point buffers and existing indexed leading reduction.
change: During canonical conversion, center scalars at half the field modulus and store a sign in their unused high bit. Signed full buckets reuse deferred Y negation. The leading column now needs only magnitudes 0 or 1 and reduces positive and negative index lists separately.
gate: Frozen and ordinary within 2% in paired median on each input. Centered needs lower paired medians and at least six of eight wins against frozen, ordinary and explicit unsigned12 on each input.
main_capture: Eight counterbalanced blocks with three primes and 17 measured calls. The separate three clocked blocks prime three calls and measure seven.
proof: All 88 exports independently verified. Route probes compare exact observed counts to the model and exercise optional workspace denial.
